actions: Rechecked the public SPLiT article and supporting-code link using read-only retrieval; file-level ZIP contents remained unavailable through the current transport.
Ran a bounded synthetic semantic-identifiability audit with drifting unlabeled prototypes, sparse identity cues, prototype crossings, cue loss, duration-semantic swaps and event-prior shifts.
Compared a mapping-permutation two-hypothesis filter against a no-permutation control across paired held-out seeds.
Extended the filter to four joint hypotheses over semantic mapping and duration regime, and compared it against the stale-duration two-hypothesis model.
Probed shared-duration abstention and isolated the condition under which duration evidence should or should not be disabled.
Persisted immutable run artifact and advanced role-local LATEST with CAS/readback.

result_summary.mapping_permutation: Prototype-crossing Brier improved by 0.02617 and cue-loss-during-crossing Brier by 0.05338 versus a filter that assumes track identity never permutes, with matched-regime Brier unchanged within bootstrap uncertainty.
result_summary.duration_regime: When duration semantics also swapped, the joint mapping-duration filter reduced Brier by 0.34155 in the mixed scenario and 0.35400 in duration-swap-only versus the stale-duration two-hypothesis model; stale false memory admissions fell from 46.454% to 0.0064% in the mixed scenario and from 31.156% to 0.0818% in duration-swap-only.
result_summary.negative_boundary: Always carrying a duration-switch hypothesis is too conservative when duration semantics are stable, especially under long cue loss. Semantic ambiguity by itself is not enough reason to discard duration evidence; duration-regime uncertainty needs its own posterior-predictive gate.
result_summary.scope: Synthetic bounded causal control and memory-utility proxy; not SPLiT reproduction and not a direct rerun of the prior PAST/GROUSE-like or Oja-like angular-error controllers.

exact_next_action: Continue read-only SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Build a hybrid controller that defaults to the two-hypothesis mapping-permutation filter and activates the joint duration-regime model only under calibrated posterior-predictive duration-change evidence with hysteresis. Calibrate on disjoint matched and duration-stable cue-loss streams, then retest mixed shifts and exact cue loss/recovery with larger held-out seeds. Feed the guarded posterior into actual fast PAST/GROUSE-like and slow Oja-like dormant-memory controllers with tracker-specific admission/restore policies and require simultaneous post-silence and post-switch improvement.

blockers: Public S1 Code.zip file contents remain unavailable through the current read-only transport.
